name: print-social-dark-marketing-webinar-post-with-yellow-date-pills
title: Dark 'Digital Marketing Experts' webinar post with a grid of yellow and white date pills
whatItIs: A square post with a man in a white shirt checking his phone, darkened left side with a white and yellow headline, four pill-shaped schedule items pairing grey date tabs (SAT 9th JUN) with yellow or white topic blocks, a 'Register now' outlined button and contacts.
whatItMeans: Informative and busy-but-tidy; date pills turn a schedule into a compact visual list.
techniques: Split each session into a date tab and topic block.
Alternate block colours to separate sessions.
Darken one side of the photo for legible type.

vocabulary.definition: A capsule combining a date and a title.
Darkened area of a photo to hold text.
